source_text: Τῶν γὰρ σιδηρῶν κνημῶν τῶν νῦν ἐπικρωτουσῶν ἐπὶ τὼ ἴχνη τῶν ποδῶν καὶ τοὺς δακτύλους χωρησάντων κατὼ τὴν τοῦ φοβεροῦ θηρίου δεῖξζιν, καθὼς ἐν τοῖς ἔμ.- προσθεν καιροῖς σεσήμανται, ἥξει ἀπ᾿ οὐρανῶν ὁ λίθος ὁ πατάξας τὴν εἰκόνα καὶ συντρίψας αὐτὴν καὶ μεταστήσει πάσας τὰς βασιλείας καὶ δώσει τὴν βασιλείαν ἁγίοις ὑψίστου. οὗτος ὁ γενηθεὶς ὅρος μέγα καὶ πληρώσας τὴν γῆν, περὶ οὗ εἴρηται “ ἐθεώρουν ἐν ὁραΐ-- ματι τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχό-- μενος ὡς υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἕως τοῦ παλαιοῦ τῶν ἡμερῶν ἔφθα-- σεν καὶ αὐτῷ ἐδύθη ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ βασιλεία καὶ πάν- τες λαοί, φυλαὶ καὶ γλῶσσαι δουλεύσουσιν αὐτῷ. ἐξουσία αὐτοῦ ἐξουσία αἰώνιος ἥτις οὐ παρελεύσεται καὶ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ οὐ διαφθαρήσεται."
pass_a_gloss: For of the iron horns that now trample upon the tracks of the feet and the toes that have filled according to the sign of the fearful beast, as in the former times it has been indicated, the stone will come from the heavens that strikes the image and crushes it and will remove all the kingdoms and will give the kingdom to the saints of the Most High. This that has been made great boundary and filled the earth, concerning which it has been said: I was looking in a vision of the night and behold, coming with the clouds of heaven like a son of man and he arrived at the Ancient of Days and to him was given the authority and the honor and the kingdom and all peoples, tribes, and languages will serve him. His authority is an eternal authority which will not pass away and his kingdom will not be destroyed.

choices.why: The Greek text uses ὅρος, which means boundary or limit, not ὄρος, which means mountain.
The verb πατάσσω means to strike or hit.
The verb συντρίβω means to crush or shatter.

bible_refs.note: coming with the clouds of heaven like a son of man

pass_b_english: The iron horns now trample the very tracks of the feet and the toes that have taken their place in line with the sign of the terrifying beast, just as was indicated in former times. From the heavens a stone will come to strike the image and crush it; it will remove every kingdom and give the kingdom to the saints of the Most High. This stone has become a great boundary and has filled the earth. Scripture speaks of it: “I was watching in a vision of the night, and behold, one like a son of man was coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was presented before him. To him were given dominion and glory and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that shall not pass away, and his kingdom shall not be destroyed” (Daniel 7:13-14).

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B both correctly handle the distinction between ὅρος (boundary) and ὄρος (mountain), as noted in the lemmas. The scripture citation (Daniel 7:13-14) in Pass B is correctly identified and added as per the instructions for scripture identification. The OCR debris (e.g., 'ἔμ.-', 'ὁραΐ--') was handled by the translators without introducing errors.
